title: Runbook: failed or locking schema migration
text: Symptoms: Flyway/Liquibase validation failed, 'relation does not exist', 'column does not exist', 'lock timeout' on ALTER TABLE, app fails on startup after deploy. Actions: halt rollout, check migration history table, restore backward-compatible schema (expand/contract), roll back application to previous version, never edit an applied migration.

title: Runbook: missing or invalid configuration
text: Symptoms: 'missing required environment variable', 'could not resolve placeholder', 'invalid value for property', NullPointerException on config bean, service crash-loops immediately after deploy. Actions: diff config between previous and current release, restore the missing variable or secret reference, add startup validation for required config.

title: Past incident: library upgrade broke serialization
text: A minor version bump of a JSON library changed default serialization; downstream consumers rejected payloads. Symptoms: NoSuchMethodError, ClassNotFoundException, ModuleNotFoundError, ImportError, incompatible types after dependency bump. Actions: pin previous version, roll back, add contract tests for serialized payloads, review lockfile diff.

title: Runbook: OOMKilled and memory leaks
text: Symptoms: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space, container OOMKilled, GC overhead limit exceeded, rising memory after deploy, 'no space left on device', thread pool exhausted, connection pool exhausted. Actions: roll back, capture heap dump, compare memory limits with previous release, check for unbounded caches or connection leaks.

title: Runbook: downstream dependency timeouts
text: Symptoms: read timed out, 504 Gateway Timeout, 503 from upstream, circuit breaker open, connection refused to payment or inventory service. Often the deployed service changed timeouts, retries, or call volume. Actions: check dependency health dashboards, compare client timeout and retry config, enable circuit breaker, consider rollback if caused by new call pattern.

title: Past incident: rotated credentials not propagated
text: A secret rotation was deployed to one service but not its clients, causing 401 Unauthorized and 403 Forbidden. Related symptoms: invalid_grant, token expired, certificate has expired, PKIX path building failed, SSL handshake failure. Actions: verify secret versions across services, re-sync secret store, renew certificate, roll back credential change.

title: Runbook: application exception spike after deploy
text: Symptoms: new NullPointerException, TypeError, KeyError, IndexOutOfBounds, IllegalStateException, HTTP 500 rate increase on a specific endpoint right after deploy. Actions: identify first-seen exceptions in the new release, correlate with changed files, roll back or disable the feature flag, add regression test.

title: Runbook: CI test failures blocking or preceding deploy
text: Symptoms: CI run FAILED with failing tests, AssertionError, expected vs actual mismatch, flaky test retries. If deployment proceeded despite failed tests, treat as high risk. Actions: block promotion, inspect failing tests, quarantine only proven-flaky tests with an owner and ticket, re-run pipeline.

title: Runbook: node, network, or DNS failure
text: Symptoms: ImagePullBackOff, node NotReady, DNS resolution failure (UnknownHostException, NXDOMAIN), network unreachable, load balancer health checks failing across unrelated services. Usually not caused by the code change. Actions: check cluster and cloud provider status, verify image registry access, reschedule pods, escalate to platform team.

title: Past incident: non-concurrent index build locked orders table
text: A migration created an index without CONCURRENTLY on a large table. Writes blocked for 9 minutes; logs showed 'canceling statement due to lock timeout' and 'deadlock detected'. Resolution: kill the migration, use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, run heavy migrations out of band.

title: Past incident: retry storm against payment provider
text: Release increased client retries from 1 to 5 without jitter. A brief provider slowdown became a retry storm: 429 Too Many Requests and read timeouts. Resolution: roll back retry config, add exponential backoff with jitter and a retry budget.

title: Guide: recognizing a healthy deployment
text: A healthy deployment shows successful CI, no new ERROR/FATAL lines, readiness checks passing, and steady request rates. Isolated WARN lines that also existed before the deploy are not incidents. Recommended action: continue monitoring; no rollback.

title: Past incident: feature flag defaulted on in production
text: A feature flag defaulted to enabled in production configuration, exposing an unfinished code path. Symptoms appeared as errors in one endpoint only for flagged traffic. Resolution: disable flag, make flag defaults explicit per environment.

title: Past incident: DB connection pool exhaustion
text: New endpoint held DB connections during an external call. Symptoms: 'Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms', HikariPool exhausted, thread starvation. Resolution: release connections before remote calls, size pool to match concurrency, roll back.

title: Runbook: OAuth / JWT validation failures
text: Symptoms: JWT signature does not match, invalid issuer, invalid audience, token not yet valid (clock skew), JWKS fetch failure. Actions: compare auth config between releases, check key rotation, verify NTP on hosts.
